package_info.why_malicious: The ATMZOW Magecart script is designed to steal sensitive payment and donor information from e-commerce and donation websites by injecting malicious JavaScript into payment pages, exfiltrating data to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

execution_context.file_location: Injected JavaScript on payment/donation page (Magento CMS frontend)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code collects credit card and personal information from form fields on the payment page, then sends this data via HTTPS POST to an attacker-controlled domain, resulting in credential and payment data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code surreptitiously collects sensitive payment information and exfiltrates it to an external server, which is a hallmark of Magecart skimming attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate payment pages should only transmit payment data to trusted payment processors, not to unknown third-party domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate analytics or payment integrations may collect form data, but only transmit it to authorized, well-known endpoints.
key_indicators: Collection of credit card and personal data from DOM
Network request to untrusted or hardcoded external domain
Execution only on sensitive payment/donation pages

attack_chain.action: Attacker injects Magecart (ATMZOW) JavaScript into the Magento CMS payment/donation page.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code executes in the browser of site visitors.

attack_chain.action: Malicious JavaScript collects payment and personal information from form fields as users enter data.
Collected data is sent via HTTPS POST to attacker-controlled infrastructure.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker receives stolen payment and donor information.

behavioral_signatures: JavaScript code collecting payment or personal data from form fields
Network requests from payment pages to untrusted or hardcoded external domains
Unexpected script injection into Magento CMS frontend
file_indicators: Injected or obfuscated JavaScript in payment/donation page templates
Unusual script tags or inline event handlers in Magento CMS files
network_indicators: Outbound HTTPS POST requests from payment pages to domains not associated with legitimate payment processors
Connections to known Magecart C2 infrastructure
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unauthorized JavaScript modifications in payment/donation pages, inspect network traffic for POST requests to unknown domains during payment form submission, and scan Magento CMS files for injected or obfuscated scripts that access sensitive form fields.
